primary_title: The SH2B1 Adaptor Protein Associates with a Proximal Region of the Erythropoietin Receptor
decision_basis: Primary EPOR site-recruitment and SH2B1 knockdown assays support a pY343/pY401 site-set adaptor edge with bounded negative-regulatory readout.
limitations_preserved: Preserve pY343/pY401 site-set, SH2B1, EPO/Ba-F3 context and no single-site exclusivity, CNS/SCI or terminal-TF inference.
